answer.description: The reply to the patient, in the patient language, with [n] after each sentence that uses a source (n = its position in citations)

citations.description: Ids of record items or guideline chunks that support the answer

suggested_actions.description: Zero or more of: open_care_access, log_glucose, book_appointment, view_plan, call_emergency

needs_clinician_review.description: True when only the clinician can answer

topic.description: Short topic label, e.g. glucose, medication, food, activity, labs, care_navigation, other
